biography.plain_text: Ronald Wayne Gilden is an American healthcare entrepreneur and the founder of Nova Healthcare, a private treatment service within Leeds Cancer Centre. His business grew through partnerships with NHS consultants and hospitals. He brought Aspen Healthcare into Nova as a co-owner, supporting expansion plans for cancer, blood disorders and neurological conditions.

long_biography.plain_text:
Ronald Gilden helped hospitals acquire and maintain radiotherapy equipment. As chief executive of Healthcare Technologies International, he led the managed equipment business on the Leeds cancer centre project. His company compared manufacturers with the hospital trust, while clinicians selected the equipment. The agreement included scheduled replacement of linear accelerators as technology advanced.

At Proton International, Gilden has structured client and supply partnerships and overseen the allocation of project resources. His work has also included coordinating NHS patient referrals for proton therapy. The company designs facilities, installs equipment and trains staff before supporting day-to-day operations. It also owns and operates a treatment centre in South Florida.
